product_download.implementation_status: Implemented and verified in the built browser app; native Hancom HWP screen parity remains unverified.
product_download.source: Capture a specific stored document/version, fetch its bytes, and verify document/version association, declared byte size and SHA-256. Never read or export the live editor buffer.
product_download.isolation: Verify the pinned binding and WASM hashes, create a separate HwpDocument, and free all objects after success or failure.
product_download.export: Use exportHwpWithReport once; take both content-loss report and bytes from that same output artifact. Require schemaVersion 1, outputFormat hwp, count 0 and an empty losses array.
product_download.checks_before_download: Check CFB signature, bounded output size, and reopen the emitted bytes in the isolated engine; require exact getTextFileText and page-count preservation.
product_download.failure: Do not offer the failed HWP output; show the error and retain the HWPX download path.
product_download.source_and_history: Read-only saved-version export; no server save, source-blob modification, historical-version change or mutation of unsaved editor text.

coverage: Actual menu download and CFB signature
